Declaration of Cash Dividends to Unlisted Preferred Shares

In its May 26, 2026 meeting, the Board of Directors of Bank of Commerce declared cash dividends to be paid out of the unrestricted retained earnings of the Bank as of December 31, 2025, distributable to stockholders of record as of June 19, 2026, to be paid on July 15, 2026 at P0.66 per unlisted preferred share.

The payment to the unlisted Preferred Shares is in fulfillment of the cumulative payments from September 2024 to August 2025 as per the terms of the shares.The books of the Bank will be closed from June 20, 2026 to June 23, 2026.

docs.title: PHR: Material Information/Transactions
docs.text:
Material Information pertaining to PH Resorts Group Holdings, Inc.

On 17 December 2025, Lapulapu Leisure Inc. and Lapulapu Land Corp. (“LLI-LLC”), subsidiaries of PH Resorts Group Holdings, Inc. (“PHR” or the “Company”), received notice from the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (“PAGCOR”) of the PAGCOR Board’s approval of the revocation of the Provisional License issued to LLI-LLC for its integrated resort and casino project located in Mactan, Cebu (the “Project”).The Company notes that the PAGCOR Board’s aforementioned approval is not expected to have a material effect on the Company’s current financials, considering that LLI-LLC has not commenced commercial operations of the Project. Accordingly, the revocation of the Provisional License is not expected to materially impact the Company’s existing financial position. The Company will continue to explore other business opportunities and shall make the appropriate disclosures to keep the public informed of developments, including its future plans, as and when these are determined, in accordance with applicable laws, rules, and disclosure requirements of the Philippine Stock Exchange and other relevant regulatory authorities.

It should be noted that the partnership discussions with EEI Corporation ("EEI") for the completion of the Project have not ripened to the execution of definitive agreements. Thus, considering the aforementioned decision of the PAGCOR Board, the partnership with EEI is no longer feasible.

docs.title: REDC: Acquisition or Disposition of Shares of Another Corporation
docs.text:
ACQUISITION OF 100% OF THE CAPITAL STOCK OF TAFT HYDROENERGY CORPORATION (THEC) AND ITS 15.93MW TUBIG HYDROPOWER PLANT LOCATED IN THE VISAYAS, BY THE COMPANY AND OTHER ENTITIES, SUBJECT TO CLOSING CONDITIONS.

ON 28 MAY 2026, THE COMPANY ALONG WITH OTHER ENTITIES, EXECUTED A SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT (SPA) WITH THE SELLERS OVER THE LATTER'S SHAREHOLDINGS IN THEC REPRESENTING 100% OF THE CAPITAL STOCK THEREOF (THE SALE SHARES). THEC OWNS THE 15.93MW TUBIG HYDROPOWER PLANT LOCATED IN THE VISAYAS (THE NEW ASSET).

THE ACQUISITION OF THEC AND ITS 15.93MW TUBIG HYDROPOWER PLANT (THE NEW ASSET) WILL FURTHER GROW THE PORTFOLIO OF OPERATIONAL HYDROPOWER PLANTS OF THE COMPANY, AND THEREBY CONTRIBUTE TO AND INCREASE THE COMPANY'S INCOME AND CASHFLOW.UPON CONCLUSION OF THIS TRANSACTION, THE NEW ASSET WILL BE THE 10TH OPERATIONAL HYDROPOWER PLANT OF THE COMPANY THEREBY INCREASING THE COMPANY'S OPERATIONAL CAPACITY BY AROUND 45%.

UPON CLOSING THE TRANSACTION, THE PARTIES TO THE SPA WILL EXECUTE DEEDS OF SALE OVER THE SHARES OF THEC.

TAFT HYDROENERGY CORPORATION IS A RE DEVELOPER DULY REGISTERED WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY, AND IS THE OWNER OF THE 15.93MW TUBIG HYDROPOWER PLANT SITUATED IN THE VISAYAS REGION.

THE TOTAL CONSIDERATION FOR THIS TRANSACTION IS P3.925B PAYABLE UPON CLOSING UNDER THE SPA.

CASHFLOW OF THE HYDROPOWER BUSINESS

CASH AND FINANCING.THE FULL PAYMENT FOR THE ACQUISITION SHARES WILL BE MADE UPON SATISFACTION OF THE CLOSING CONDITIONS STATED IN THE SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT.

COMPLIANCE WITH GOVERNMENTAL AUTHORIZATIONS, SUCH AS BUT NOT LIMITED TO PCC CLEARANCE, PUNCHLIST, COMPLIANCE WITH FUNDAMENTAL AND BUSINESS WARRANTIES, REQUIRED CONSENT FROM AND PROVISION OF NOTICES TO COUNTER-PARTIES INCLUDING LENDER/S, AND OTHER CUSTOMARY CLOSING CONDITIONS.

SHARES TO BE ACQUIRED BY THE FOLLOWING ENTITIES INCLUDING THE COMPANY:REDC, THE COMPANY: 520,000,000 TOKAI CORPORATION: 520,000,000 SOUTH EAST ENERGY CORPORATION: 260,000,000

THE ACQUISITION OF THEC AND ITS 15.93MW TUBIG HYDROPOWER PLANT (THE NEW ASSET) WILL ENTAIL THE OPERATION OF THE 10TH HYDROPOWER PLANT OF THE COMPANY, THEREBY INCREASING THE COMPANY’S OPERATIONAL CAPACITY BY APPROXIMATELY 45%, AND FURTHER GROWING REDC’S PORTFOLIO OF HYDROPOWER BUSINESS.

docs.text:
Approval of the Board for the establishment of a Chief Executive Officer Stock Option Plan (CSOP)

The CSOP is an incentive to motivate excellent performance of the CEO, as the main driver in steering the Company towards achieving its goals. The CSOP is a stock option that grants the CEO the privilege to subscribe to preferred shares which are non-voting, non-cumulative, non-participating, convertible, and redeemable at such terms and conditions as may be determined by the Board. The subscription price shall be determined by the Board at the time of grant. As the beneficiary of the CSOP, the Chairman recused himself from the deliberations and voting on this matter.

Related disclosures on the proposed creation of Preferred C Shares, and conversion of Preferred A Shares after conversion to the proposed newly-created Preferred C Shares.
